content:
Onboarding checklist (assistant panel)

In-panel checklist guides import from other browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Brave), privacy framing, OAuth sign-in, and “first AI turn”—with dismiss and progress prefs.

What this is

A checklist at the top of the assistant guides import from Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Brave—including passwords if you choose—plus privacy reassurance, Kahana sign-in, and your first AI turn.

Imported passwords stay in your on-device login vault; they are not uploaded to Kahana as part of import. The assistant does not receive your vault contents. Details: Import data from other browsers.

How to use it

  • Expand or collapse the checklist with its header control.
  • Work steps in order; each step deep-links to the right surface (migration, auth, etc.).
  • Dismissing the checklist is remembered for the profile (browser.oasis.onboarding.* prefs).

Notes and limits

Import requires the other browser installed or profile data available on disk; failures show inline errors.
